info.name: Plangrep API Test
info.description: Drop-in collection for every public Open API endpoint documented in this repository. Set collection variables before sending requests. Open API routes use Bearer {{apiKey}}.

variable.description: Bearer token for Open API requests.
Last review stream sequence received. Use -1 to start from the beginning.
Artifact path from an API response.
Source catalog URI from search or citations.
Use a unique value for each new mutation; reuse the exact key when retrying.
Document ID returned by Register uploads.
Upload token returned by Register uploads.
Multipart upload ID returned by Register uploads.
Signed direct-upload URL returned by Register uploads.

request.description: Lists projects visible to the organization. Requires jobs:read.
Creates an API project. Requires jobs:write.
Gets a project state. Requires jobs:read.
Gets project and source-index readiness. Requires jobs:read.
Searches projects by name and indexed sources. Requires jobs:read.
Gets aliases, key files, disciplines, and counts. Requires jobs:read.
Reconciles missing or terminal source indexes. Requires jobs:write.
Schedules repair for missing normalized region data. Requires jobs:write.
Lists jobs across visible projects. Requires jobs:read.
Lists jobs for a project. Requires jobs:read.
Creates a document-processing job. Requires jobs:write.
Gets job state. Requires jobs:read.
Gets a completed job's normalized result. Requires jobs:read.
Resumes a job blocked by insufficient credits. Requires jobs:write.
Cancels a non-terminal job. Requires jobs:write.
Registers file metadata before direct upload. Requires jobs:write.
Uploads raw bytes to the signed URL returned by Register uploads. This is an R2 upload, not an Open API endpoint.
Finalizes uploads and starts processing. Requires jobs:write.
Lists extracted files. Requires jobs:read.
Gets an extracted file. Requires jobs:read.
Lists extracted drawing sheets. Requires jobs:read.
Gets a drawing sheet. Requires jobs:read.
Lists extracted drawing regions. Requires jobs:read.
Gets a drawing region. Requires jobs:read.
Lists regions on a sheet. Requires jobs:read.
Lists specification documents. Requires jobs:read.
Gets a specification document. Requires jobs:read.
Lists sections in a specification. Requires jobs:read.
Gets full specification section text. Requires jobs:read.
Lists processed document entities. Requires jobs:read.
Gets a processed document entity. Requires jobs:read.
Searches indexed project sources. Requires jobs:read.
Reads bounded text for a source catalog URI. Requires the existing source-read permission.
Fetches bytes from a job result snapshot. Requires artifacts:read.
Fetches bytes from a project entity or source catalog. Requires artifacts:read.
Streams artifact bytes using a one-time token. This route is unauthenticated.
Validates an artifact download token without consuming it. This route is unauthenticated.
Lists project reviews. Requires reviews:read.
Creates a named review. Requires reviews:write. Idempotency-Key is required.
Gets a review. Requires reviews:read.
Lists review messages and assistant citations. Requires reviews:read.

Submits a text question and starts a durable execution. Requires reviews:write. Idempotency-Key is required. Copy execution.id into executionId, then open the SSE stream request; the response also includes execution.streamUrl.
Polls a durable review execution. Requires reviews:read. The response includes streamUrl for SSE or NDJSON events.

query.description: Last public sequence received. Use -1 to replay from the beginning.

request.description: Streams sanitized public review events. Requires reviews:read. Postman displays this request in its EventStream response view. Each event data field is the documented JSON event; save its sequence in streamAfter before reconnecting. Change Accept to application/x-ndjson for JSON lines.
Requests asynchronous cancellation. Continue polling until status is cancelled. Requires reviews:write.
